description: Provision a Google Cloud Vpcaccess VPCAccessConnector via Config Connector. Fields mirror the vpcaccess.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 VPCAccessConnector spec.

ipCidrRange.description: Immutable. The range of internal addresses that follows RFC 4632 notation. Example: '10.132.0.0/28'.

location.description: Location represents the geographical location of the VPCAccessConnector. Specify a region name. Reference: GCP definition of regions/zones (https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/regions-zones/)

machineType.description: Immutable. Machine type of VM Instance underlying connector. Default is e2-micro.

maxInstances.description: Immutable. Maximum value of instances in autoscaling group underlying the connector.

maxThroughput.description: Immutable. Maximum throughput of the connector in Mbps, must be greater than 'min_throughput'. Default is 300.

minInstances.description: Immutable. Minimum value of instances in autoscaling group underlying the connector.

minThroughput.description: Immutable. Minimum throughput of the connector in Mbps. Default and min is 200.

networkRef.description: Immutable. Name or self_link of the VPC network. Required if 'ip_cidr_range' is set. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `selfLink` field of a `ComputeNetwork` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: Immutable. The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `Project` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

subnet.description: Immutable. The subnet in which to house the connector.

nameRef.description:
Immutable. Subnet name (relative, not fully qualified). E.g. if the full subnet selfLink is
https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/subnetworks/{subnetName} the correct input for this field would be {subnetName}". Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `ComputeSubnetwork` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectRef.description: Immutable. Project in which the subnet exists. If not set, this project is assumed to be the project for which the connector create request was issued. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `Project` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/
